honest_limitations: The external normative anchor (DNV / CSR ply-level laminate failure criterion clause values) is WITHHELD: no retrievable copy exists from this sandbox (retrieval log with HTTP status codes in the ledger). The graded anchors are classic-solution / calibration anchors, not code-clause transcriptions.
The ply strength allowables are a declared input, not a retrieved value.
The FE ply stress in the bending table is the exact FSDT curvature scaled by the FE/exact deflection ratio: it measures the FE discretisation error, not an independent FE stress recovery.
3-D / interlaminar stress indices (LayeredExact3D, layered_hex20_fem) were NOT run in this closure -- status not_run, not passed.

inputs.strength_provenance: DECLARED INPUT -- the five allowables are not retrieved from a document in this sandbox (anchor ledger entry LAM-STRENGTH-INPUTS, status WITHHELD). Every compared quantity is either independent of them (A, B, D, strains, stresses) or exactly homogeneous in them (failure index, load factor), so their magnitude cannot flip a PASS/FAIL verdict.
